svg.title: Polar rotation as the clipping threshold varies
svg.desc: A deterministic threshold sweep for the tutorial's two gradient matrices, with C from 0.25 to 4.5. The clipped mean has polar angle minus 22.5 degrees when C is at most square root of 2. For square root of 2 less than C less than 4, the angle is minus arctangent of 1/(C + 1), in degrees. At C equal to 4 and above, neither example is clipped and the angle equals the original mean's minus 11.309932 degrees. A marker highlights C equal to 1. Vertical guides mark square root of 2 and 4, the two gradient norms. The dashed horizontal line is the original mean's angle. This plot contains no measured training results.
